text.title: Ios Signing And Provisioning Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the signing document: the app and the account that owns it, the secret store and its readers, every certificate, provisioning profile, App Store Connect API key and APNs credential with identifier, expiry and storage location, the per-build-config `aps-environment` to APNs host map, the rotation calendar with 30-day lead and a named person, the revocation runbook with per-type impact, and the review state before any binding action. Validator: `scripts/validate-ios-signing-and-provisioning.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: every certificate, profile, ASC key and APNs certificate has a `rotation_calendar` entry whose `rotate_by` is at least 30 days before its `expiry`, read from the portal (r-rotation-calendar-with-lead-time); every `storage_location` and `p8_storage_location` names the `secret_store`, not a laptop or a chat (r-private-keys-in-secret-store-only, r-asc-api-key-least-privilege); one `asc_api_keys` entry per pipeline or vendor (r-asc-api-key-least-privilege); `revocation_runbook.impact` has an entry for every certificate type in `certificates` and `profiles` (r-revocation-impact-documented); `owning_team_id` is the client's Team ID when `built_for_client` (r-client-account-owns-the-app).

example.note: Subject violations: a client app created under the agency's Team ID with no transfer plan (r-client-account-owns-the-app); two per-developer distribution certificates, one in the repo and one in a Slack thread, with `private_keys_outside_secret_store` true (r-private-keys-in-secret-store-only); an Admin-role ASC key shared by every pipeline and a vendor with its `.p8` on a laptop (r-asc-api-key-least-privilege); certificate-based push with no constraint and no expiry (r-apns-token-key-over-cert); a TestFlight build signed for production pointing at the sandbox host (r-push-environment-per-build-config); a rotation entry with 2 days' lead and no named person (r-rotation-calendar-with-lead-time); a revocation runbook with no per-type impact verified against a blog (r-revocation-impact-documented); and an approval with a binding action performed by the agent.

antipattern.description: A certificate or profile with no `rotation_calendar` entry, `lead_days` below 30, `rotate_by` inside 30 days of `expiry`, or an entry without a named `owner`.
antipattern.reason: r-rotation-calendar-with-lead-time: a certificate that expires on Saturday fails on the hotfix build.

antipattern.description: An ASC key with `p8_stored_at_issue` false, a `p8_storage_location` that is a person's machine or blank, a `role` of Admin or Account Holder, or one key shared by several pipelines or vendors.
antipattern.reason: r-asc-api-key-least-privilege: Apple allows the `.p8` to be downloaded once.

antipattern.description: More than one distribution certificate without `per_developer_reason`, `private_keys_outside_secret_store` true, `who_may_revoke` open to anyone, or `impact` missing a certificate type in use.
antipattern.reason: r-private-keys-in-secret-store-only, r-revocation-impact-documented: one revoke kills every ad-hoc and enterprise build in the field.

antipattern.description: A build configuration missing from `build_configs`, or an `aps_environment` whose `apns_host` disagrees with it.
antipattern.reason: r-push-environment-per-build-config: every push returns BadDeviceToken while the app looks fine.

antipattern.description: `push.auth = certificate` without `certificate_constraint` and `certificate_expiry`, or with no matching `rotation_calendar` entry.
antipattern.reason: r-apns-token-key-over-cert: an APNs certificate dies after a year, usually on a weekend.

antipattern.description: `built_for_client` true with `owning_account = agency` and no `transfer_plan`, or `owning_team_id` that is not the client's.
antipattern.reason: r-client-account-owns-the-app: the app becomes a hostage the day the contract ends.

antipattern.description: `review.status = approved` with no `reviewer` and `approved_on`, or `binding_action_performed_by_agent` true.
antipattern.reason: Human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`: revocation, rotation, transfer and submission are approved by a named human.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Signing document skeleton with the same sections and field names.
